before.headline: 2025-26 production
before.summary: Connor McDavid recorded 138 points (48 goals, 90 assists) in 82 games in 2025-26. He averaged 1.68 points per game. He played 23 minutes per game. His totals included 306 shots, 54 power-play points.
before.analysis: The 2025-26 rates provide a historical baseline. Current line assignment, power-play role and availability determine how much of that production can carry forward.

after.headline: Playmaking with shot volume
after.summary: Connor McDavid paired 90 assists with 3.7 shots per game in 2025-26 while averaging 23 minutes.
after.analysis: If shots count, the shooting contribution covers a different roster need from the assist total; the playmaking does not leave this profile dependent on assists alone. Carrying that pace forward assumes a comparable workload; more minutes would need fresh deployment evidence.

before.headline: 2025-26 production

before.analysis: The 2025-26 rates provide a historical baseline. Current line assignment, power-play role and availability determine how much of that production can carry forward.

after.headline: Volume shooter
after.summary: Nathan MacKinnon generated 4.4 shots per game in 2025-26 and scored 53 goals, converting 15.1% of his shots.
after.analysis: In leagues counting shots, that volume still contributes when goals dry up. For the goal return, separate maintaining the workload from maintaining conversion; the scoring total depends on both.

before.headline: 2025-26 production
before.summary: Nikita Kucherov recorded 130 points (44 goals, 86 assists) in 76 games in 2025-26. He averaged 1.71 points per game. He played 20.3 minutes per game. His totals included 231 shots, 37 power-play points.
before.analysis: The 2025-26 rates provide a historical baseline. Current line assignment, power-play role and availability determine how much of that production can carry forward.

after.headline: Finishing and playmaking
after.summary: Nikita Kucherov scored 44 goals on 19% shooting in 2025-26, with 3 shots per game and 86 assists.
after.analysis: Repeating the goal return at the same shot volume requires that conversion to hold. The assist contribution broadens the scoring case, while one season of high shooting efficiency alone does not establish an impending decline.

after.headline: Power-play exposure
after.summary: Leon Draisaitl earned 42 of his 97 points on the power play in 2025-26.
after.analysis: Where power-play points earn extra value, that concentration makes power-play usage a central part of the valuation. Reduced special-teams time would require more scoring elsewhere to sustain the same overall return.

before.headline: 2025-26 goaltending
before.summary: Connor Hellebuyck made 57 appearances in 2025-26. He finished with a .895 save percentage and a 2.86 goals-against average. His record was 23-23.
before.analysis: The 2025-26 results inform his outlook, but recorded appearances do not establish his current share of starts. Check the current crease allocation and confirmed starter before setting a lineup.

after.headline: Ratio recovery needed
after.summary: Connor Hellebuyck made 57 appearances in 2025-26, winning 23, with a .895 save percentage and 2.86 goals-against average.
after.analysis: If wins, saves and save percentage count, more appearances offer another chance at volume, but repeating that save rate would work against the ratio. A rebound in performance and a larger workload are separate assumptions.
